title: Scalable and telecom single-erbium system with record-long room-temperature quantum coherence
summary: Achieving long lived (μs-scale) quantum coherence at room temperature in the telecom C band remains a central unsolved challenge for solid state quantum platforms, with coherence at this timescale previously demonstrated only under vacuum cryogenic conditions at temperatures over 600 times lower.
